topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture framework and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer development and tumor evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how both mutational accumulation and epigenetic alterations confer competitive fitness to cell clones during cancer progression.

topics.label: Cell of origin and the cancer stem cell model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchies and stemness properties determine the cell of origin and drive tumor propagation across different cancers.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion, inflammation, and stromal dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stroma create permissive conditions for tumor initiation and progression.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the single-cell and spatial profiling technologies used to investigate clonal dynamics and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, transcriptional plasticity, and microenvironmental factors in driving malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
